classification.description: Operating vs financial classification for reformulated statements and the managerial balance sheet. Packs override any key under l1.classification.

notes.longterm_investments: Treated as financial (debt and marketable securities). Equity-method stakes are operating; a pack should move them when material.
notes.leases: Operating by default so NOA and enterprise value match the DCF bridge (net debt = debt - cash). Set leases_are_financial to treat lease liabilities as debt.
notes.implicit_borrowing_rate_after_tax: Rate charged on operating liabilities in ROOA and OLSPREAD.

warnings: interest not tagged in the latest year; NFE treated as zero in reformulation

predictability.label: medium
predictability.rule: between the high and low rules

asset_intensity.label: moderate
asset_intensity.rule: between the light and heavy rules
